content.json:
## Blazor errors
Errors and events from NT.Blazor.ErrorBoundary, grouped by `blazor.error.fingerprint`. Browser errors logged without the Azure Monitor add-on share one problem ID in the Failures view; the fingerprint groups them here.

content.query:
exceptions
| extend Kind = tostring(customDimensions['blazor.report.kind']), Fingerprint = tostring(customDimensions['blazor.error.fingerprint'])
| where isnotempty(Fingerprint)
| extend Source = iff(isempty(Kind), "server", "client"),
    ErrorType = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.exception.type']), type),
    Message = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.exception.message']), outerMessage),
    User = coalesce(user_AuthenticatedId, user_Id),
    FirstSeen = timestamp,
    LastSeen = timestamp,
    FirstVersion = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.app.version']), application_Version),
    LastVersion = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.app.version']), application_Version)
| summarize Occurrences = count(),
    Users = dcountif(User, isnotempty(User)),
    Sessions = dcountif(session_Id, isnotempty(session_Id)),
    arg_min(FirstSeen, FirstVersion),
    arg_max(LastSeen, LastVersion),
    Message = take_any(Message),
    Boundary = take_any(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.boundary.name'])),
    Url = take_any(tostring(customDimensions['url.full']))
    by Fingerprint, Source, ErrorType
| order by Occurrences desc
content.title: Errors by fingerprint

content.query:
let blazorErrors = (start: datetime, end: datetime) {
    exceptions
    | where timestamp between (start .. end)
    | extend Fingerprint = tostring(customDimensions['blazor.error.fingerprint'])
    | where isnotempty(Fingerprint)
};
let known = blazorErrors(ago(14d), ago(1d)) | distinct Fingerprint;
blazorErrors(ago(1d), now())
| extend FirstSeen = timestamp, FirstVersion = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.app.version']), application_Version)
| summarize Occurrences = count(),
    arg_min(FirstSeen, FirstVersion),
    ErrorType = take_any(coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.exception.type']), type)),
    Message = take_any(coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.exception.message']), outerMessage))
    by Fingerprint
| join kind=leftanti known on Fingerprint
| order by FirstSeen desc
content.title: New in the last day (not seen in the 13 days before)

content.query:
exceptions
| extend Kind = tostring(customDimensions['blazor.report.kind']), Fingerprint = tostring(customDimensions['blazor.error.fingerprint'])
| where isnotempty(Fingerprint)
| extend Source = iff(isempty(Kind), "server", "client"),
    ErrorType = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.exception.type']), type),
    Message = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions['blazor.exception.message']), outerMessage),
    User = coalesce(user_AuthenticatedId, user_Id)
| summarize Errors = count() by Source, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Errors over time by source

content.query:
customEvents
| where name startswith "blazor."
| summarize Events = count() by name, bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
| render timechart
content.title: Blazor events (stalled navigation, failed reconnection, circuit connection changes)
